persona.label: Strong all-rounder
persona.desc: The best player at the table: bets bigger when his hand is strong, folds smartly, bluffs sometimes, and pays attention to how you play. Calls a $1 bet only with a strong hand.
persona.beat: Avoid big pots with him unless your hand is strong, and change up your bet sizes so he cannot read you.

persona.label: Tight folder
persona.desc: Plays mostly good hands. If someone bets big and he has nothing decent, he folds fast. He only calls a $1 bet with a strong hand.
persona.beat: Bet bigger when you want him out, because he folds weak hands to pressure. When he calls or raises a big bet, believe him.

persona.label: Bluffer
persona.desc: Plays strong hands, bets a medium pair like it is a monster, and bluffs when nobody else shows strength. When he is really strong, he raises your big bets.
persona.beat: When everyone checks and Krish suddenly bets, he is often bluffing. Call him down with a decent pair more often.

persona.label: Wild card
persona.desc: Plays almost any hand and does not always know how strong his hand is. Makes random big bets, takes forever to act, and calls big bets whenever he thinks he has a good pair.
persona.beat: Never bluff Venky, because he calls. When you have a good hand, bet big: he will pay you. Do not read too much into his big bets.
